capabilities: Apply text transformations to selected text, notes, or files
Run AI writing commands through OpenRouter
Clean up Markdown, including preserving layout in AI responses
Summarize notes and classify or move them into folders with AI
Buy AI credits through a Constance account
extras: Privacy-sensitive: AI actions send selected input to the AI service, and error reports sent to Datadog can include file paths or content from failed operations; version 5.8.85 requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI text commands or way to run account-based, paid AI transformations on selections, notes, or files.

relations.evidence: Connect your Constance account in plugin settings.
New purchases use Paddle and USD.

summary: AI-assisted text editor that applies text transformations and AI writing commands to selected text, notes, or files via OpenRouter.
